messages.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very eager to work with you and to prove ourselves as a great long-term partner for your business!

We are happy to present our offer for a price of €47.00 per unit, along with a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We remain flexible and look forward to hearing from you soon so we can start building a strong partnership together.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body: Please consider these complete packages for the stated requirement. The forecast for part:310020 increased by 20% (fc:310020@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Thanks for the good news on the volume increase, that definitely helps us give you a better price! We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. 

But going down to 1500 ppm is a big jump for us and means extra work on the line to make sure everything is perfect. I can offer you €46.50 for the 1500 ppm target with zero chargebacks.

So, our offer is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) – revised packages and quality plan
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for moving to the 1500 ppm target. Our payment terms are fixed for this enquiry, so we must look at price and quality protection.

The producer price index PPI-D351 fell from 140.5 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11) to 123.7 (idx:PPI-D351@2026-04), a change of -11.96%. Your scorecard shows 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3), so stronger defect protection is justified.

Please review the three attached complete packages, each for 15900 pieces per year over 12 months. If they exceed your authority, could you arrange an authorized pricing review with your management? Is there also a cheaper process or material variant that meets the quality target?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

We also checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the PPI drop and the scorecard numbers you mentioned, so I can give you a better price of €46.00 for the 1500 ppm and zero chargebacks.

Since you said payment terms are fixed, we really can't go any lower on the price because we need the cash flow. So, our offer stands at a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) - packages for an authorized pricing review
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. We have already taken that index change data into account, and we already looked at the index drop last time, so that doesn't change the picture for us now.

I talked to my boss like you asked, and since we really need the cash flow, I can offer you €45.50 for the 1500 ppm target with zero chargebacks. So our Angebot is a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) - 8D commitment and revised packages
messages.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for the 8D report and for involving your management. Our index reference is PPI-D351, one of the cost drivers you named, as set out in our earlier e-mails.

Your 8D commits to the 1500 ppm target with full outgoing inspection. A chargeback option therefore carries little risk for you if the plan works. It would also give our Supplier Quality team the binding cost recovery they asked for.

The attached packages each cover 15900 pieces per year over 12 months. Could your management review them? Which one fits your improvement plan best? Can you also confirm the earliest lead time for the January call-offs, given your holiday shutdown?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) - 8D commitment and revised packages
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your message. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Regarding the January call-offs, if you send the firm orders now, we can deliver right after our holiday shutdown. We really can't accept any chargebacks because our cash flow is too tight to risk deductions, so we have to stick to zero chargebacks. Since we can't get faster payment, our price has to stay at €45.50 for the 1500 ppm target.

So, our Angebot is a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

We are very eager to work together and show you what our company can do for you as a long-term partner!

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
